rich_text_fields.html: The International Solar Alliance (ISA), through its SIDS Platform, and the GRIHA Council have launched the ISA-iSUN Design Challenge to promote the integration of solar energy and climate-resilient design into tourism infrastructure in Small Island Developing States (SIDS).
